subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should `claws export` require a healthy exact installation by default, with drifted or partial state available only through an explicit snapshot mode carrying lineage and drift metadata?
rationale: Both the current derivative-snapshot behavior and the proposed exact-state default are implementable, but they define materially different reproducibility and compatibility promises for future Claw packages and downstream lifecycle slices.

options.title: Exact by default
options.body: Require complete corroborated state for normal export and add an explicit snapshot mode with lineage and a machine-readable drift report.

options.title: Keep snapshot semantics
options.body: Accept the current derivative package as a best-effort portable snapshot and document that it does not certify exact reproducibility.

options.title: Pause the export stack
options.body: Hold this and dependent slices until the RFC settles export reproducibility, lineage, and host-local rebinding semantics.

recommendation.title: Exact by default
recommendation.body: Require complete corroborated state for normal export and add an explicit snapshot mode with lineage and a machine-readable drift report.

likelyOwner.reason: They articulated the concrete unresolved product contract and the recommended exact-versus-snapshot boundary in the PR discussion.
